name: Massey University
description: Massey University is a public university founded in 1927 as an agricultural college, with campuses in Palmerston North, Wellington and Auckland. It teaches business, creative arts, health, science, humanities and social sciences, and is known for agriculture, veterinary science and food technology.
whyIncluded: Massey has taught in Singapore since 2008 (including a joint Bachelor of Food Technology with the Singapore Institute of Technology since 2016) and was among the most-searched overseas universities from Singapore in 2025 (KiasuParents, a Singapore parents' website).

livingCosts.summary: Massey gives no estimate, so this is New Zealand's visa minimum of NZ$20,000 a year for all living costs. Massey notes actual costs vary and may be higher; tuition and airfares excluded.
livingCosts.notes: FALLBACK - visa minimum, not a Massey estimate: Massey's 'Living in New Zealand' page gives no cost-of-living breakdown, only that Immigration New Zealand requires NZ$20,000 per year of study for living costs on top of course fees (plus return airfares). NZ$20,000 / 12 is one combined figure for accommodation, food, transport and personal costs, so it is all in housing and the other categories are 0. Massey notes living costs vary considerably and may need to be more.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Information Sciences (Computer Science)
programmes.summary: Estimated yearly tuition for international students in the Computer Science major for 2027; other majors differ. Student services fee included; health insurance is extra. Fees reviewed yearly.
programmes.notes: 2027 estimated international tuition for full-time study (120 credits) in the Computer Science major; 360 credits = 3 years. Other BInfSc majors $42,250-$46,950. Compulsory = 2027 student services fee for on-campus students, $10.30/credit x 120 = $1,236 (quoted on the page). Excludes Studentsafe insurance (~$999/yr). Fees reviewed annually. 2024 history: NZ$37,460 is Massey's own 2024 International Qualification Guide figure (per 120 credits, incl. GST, 'correct for 2024', Computer Science major), read 2026-10-04 from a mirror copy on college-contact.com (an agency site) because Massey no longer hosts it (its /documents/797/ prospectus slot is overwritten each year and now serves the 2027 edition); PDF metadata: Author 'Massey University', Title 'International Prospectus 2024', Subject 'January 2024'. The guide states no student services fee, so the 2024 row carries tuition only. No 2025 figures on file: every Massey fee URL now serves 2027 figures, the 2024/2025 University Calendars contain no fee amounts, and no Massey-hosted 2025 guide was found. Massey no longer offers engineering (school closed after the Oct 2023 College of Sciences change proposal). 2026 history: NZ$42,300 is the '2026 tuition fees' international figure (full-time, 120 credits, incl. GST) this qualification page stated before Massey switched it to 2027 figures, read 2026-10-04 from Common Crawl captures of the same URL in CC-MAIN-2025-51 (2025-12-12) and CC-MAIN-2026-17 (2026-04-23), all showing the same 2026 figure; compulsory = the 2026 on-campus student services fee $1,164 (120 credits) stated on the same captured page and on Massey's non-tuition fees page. The Massey-authored 2026 International Qualification Guide was not found (the agency mirrors located are the 2027 edition or older guides).
